<function name="GetDoubleClickingEnabled" parent="DLabel" type="panelfunc">
	<description>
Returns whether or not double clicking will call <page>DLabel:DoDoubleClick</page>.

See <page>DLabel:SetDoubleClickingEnabled</page>.
	</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">true = enabled, false means disabled</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
